$comment: Fake deployment scenario of the standalone robot_runtime (--fake-scenario).
An entry applies from its elapsed_us onwards and holds until the next entry.
elapsed_us is monotonic from process start, mandatory and strictly increasing.
feedback.count and every joint or IMU field are optional: what an entry leaves
out keeps the value of the previous entry, ultimately the initial snapshot of
the configured joints (valid, connected, control frequency, all values zero).
joints[i] addresses joint i and must stay inside the effective count.
Every tick refreshes the receive stamp of the injected samples to the current
monotonic time, which keeps them fresh for timeouts.feedback_us;
imu.rx_stamp_us is an offset from the current monotonic time for the IMU stamp
only (0 keeps it fresh, a negative offset ages it). An entry with
"paused": true holds the previous receive stamps, so the samples age and can
lapse; the next entry without paused refreshes again.
write_result.accepted drives FakeBackend::SetWriteAccepted and holds until the
next entry that sets it. write_result.error_code is refused: the fake backend
reports its own rejection code and exposes no way to set one.
